schema: CREATE TABLE rsi_storage_domains ( domain TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0), record_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(record_count >= 0 AND record_count <= 65536), record_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2 CHECK(record_bytes >= 2 AND record_bytes <= 268435456) ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE rsi_storage_records ( domain TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, value BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(domain, key), FOREIGN KEY(domain) REFERENCES rsi_storage_domains(domain) ON DELETE CASCADE ) STRICT
CREATE TRIGGER rsi_storage_records_delete_count AFTER DELETE ON rsi_storage_records BEGIN UPDATE rsi_storage_domains SET record_count = record_count - 1 WHERE domain = OLD.domain; END
CREATE TRIGGER rsi_storage_records_insert_count AFTER INSERT ON rsi_storage_records BEGIN UPDATE rsi_storage_domains SET record_count = record_count + 1 WHERE domain = NEW.domain; END
